project_type: Native Android app using Jetpack Compose + Material 3
build_system: Gradle 8.7, AGP 8.7.2, KSP for Room compiler. Build uses ./gradlew assembleDebug. google-services plugin applied conditionally based on google-services.json existence.
test_framework: JUnit 4 + Espresso + Compose UI testing (minimal tests exist)
test_command: ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace (no dedicated test task since no unit tests exist yet)
verification_instructions: Run ./gradlew assembleDebug and confirm it succeeds without errors. The CI workflow uses './gradlew assembleDebug || gradle assembleDebug'. The build must pass.
setup_instructions: 1. Ensure JDK 17 is available. 2. Create google-services.json in app/ directory. 3. Run ./gradlew assembleDebug
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - cannot download packages or dependencies from the internet. Must work only with code already present in the repository. Cannot run Gradle builds (no internet to resolve dependencies). Use AST-level validation (ensure files compile logically). Supabase credentials come from BuildConfig (local.properties or env vars). In CI, placeholder empty strings are used.
contribution_requirements: Must not break the build. CI uses ./gradlew assembleDebug. Keep all existing gradle dependencies. Do not change build.gradle.kts dependency versions.
key_patterns: MVVM architecture with ViewModels using StateFlow. Repositories fetch from Supabase with try/catch fallback to mock data. SupabaseClient singleton initialized in Application class. Screens use Scaffold + LazyColumn pattern. Navigation via NavHost with sealed class Screen routes. Theme uses RexoTheme accessor object wrapping MaterialTheme. GlassSurface/FloatingGlassCard for card components. Serialization uses kotlinx.serialization.
directory_structure: Root: build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle.kts, app/. App module: app/build.gradle.kts, app/src/main/java/com/rexo/marketplace/ with subdirs: data/ (local/, model/, remote/, repository/), ui/ (screens/, components/, theme/, viewmodel/), navigation/, services/, utils/. Resources: app/src/main/res/ with values/, xml/, drawable/, mipmap-*/. Assets: assets/logo.png at root. Supabase schema: supabase/schema.sql.
